title: [M4] Deterministic PNG-sequence ingestion and staging
accepted_criteria: Import ordered PNG sequences without inferred choreography, retain raw source hash plus staged pixel/asset identities and explicit source order.
Validate dimensions, decode budget, transparency expectations, hashes and invalid frame order with exact source/requirement error IDs.
Same sources/settings and pinned decoder/color policy reproduce identical staged hashes; original files are immutable.
Expose imported candidates to the existing assignment/preview API and local import tray without automatic assignment/approval.
